description: Daily nutrition activity with per-kg macro targets: protein 1.6-2.2 g/kg, carbs 4-6 g/kg, fat 0.7-1.0 g/kg. Covers the g_per_kg unit introduced in schema v1.4.0.

known_divergence.note: TS emits 1 (integer), Elixir emits 1.0 (float) for the value 1.0. Both are semantically equal. Normalized by coercing whole-number floats to integers (rule 5).
